lines.en: : Milk...eggs...water...
: Wait, what does she need me to buy water for? Can’t she just use the tap?
I’m on my way home from[school] and-
Actually, let me correct that.
I was on my way home from[school]...but then Ami decided to text me a list of things I apparently need to pick up on the way home.
They’re all relatively simple ingredients, so it’s not like it’s a hassle or anything, but...
Well, let's just say that I wanted to use my night for something other than just running errands.
She won't mind if I'm a little late, right?
Maybe I can hang around here for a little while before heading back?
It’s not often that I’m in this part of town, so...I doubt there's any harm in me checking out a few extra shops or something.
Worse comes to worst, I can always just tell Ami I got lost.
I cross the street and immediately find a small cafe I've never seen before.
Without putting any thought into it, I push open the doors and wander inside- hoping to find a beautiful girl that is at least slightly open to the idea of having sex with me.
And I wind up finding Haruka.
Cool.
: Oh, hey. What are you doing here?
: Haruka?
: Yeah, hey! Sorry, I just...wasn't expecting to see you out of nowhere.
: I'm just dropping by to grab some dinner for tonight, but...
: I actually left my wallet at home...
: So...now I am about to postpone dinner and...go get that.
: Haru-chan, you don’t need to go home, dear. You’re here every day.
: Let this one be on us. The least we can do to pay you back is give you a free meal every once in a while...
An old woman, presumably the store owner, calls out to Haruka from behind the counter.
: What? No! I couldn’t do something like that to you!
: You remember I run a cafe as well, right? I know what it's like to miss out on a sale because of forgetful people like this.
: Just...give me like half an hour and I'll be right back. I promise.
: You live around here, Haruka?
: Right around the corner, actually.
: I used to stop by this place every day with my-
: My friend.
: My...uhh...
: My friend and I would come here all the time and...meet up for dinner and stuff.
: But...enough about me! Do you live around here as well?
: I’ve only seen you at the cafe and...the bistro that one time- so I have no idea if you’re local or not.
: I don't really live around here, no. Just...passing by while running some errands.
: It's no big deal, though. I'll probably just wind up taking the bus home anyway.
: You don’t have a car?
: Is that surprising?
: What? No, I...I didn’t mean anything bad by it, I swear. I mean, it's not like you even really need one in Kumon-mi.
: I can always give you a ride home if you want, though.
: Only thing is we’d need to head back over to my place first since I didn't drive here.
: Plus, I'd also like to come back and pick up dinner once I can actually, like...you know. Pay for it.
: Are you sure? I wouldn’t want to burden you.
: Dude, it’s totally fine. I don’t mind at all. In fact, I welcome the company. I just cleaned my living room and no one's been around to be impressed by how nice it looks.
: Do you not have people over very often?
: No one other than the same two people who have been coming around for years now.
: Apart from them, it's probably been...three or four years since anyone else came over?
: Wow.
: I am incredibly lonely. Please comfort me by blessing me with your presence.
: Platonically, of course. I promise I’m not hitting on you.
: Unless...
: Wait? What? No. Don't be awkward, Haruka. Just be yourself.
: I...don’t really know how to interpret this exchange, but if you’re that determined to have me over, I’ve got no problems at all.
: I can’t stay that long, though. My [niece] is expecting me with groceries.
: Wait, you live with your [niece]? I had no idea.
: Of course you had no idea. We’ve only had like two real conversations since we’ve met.
: Yeah, but that’s your fault. It’s not like you don’t have my number.
: And pretty soon, I’ll have your address as well.
: I’m sorry. That sounded a lot creepier than I wanted it to.
: I don't know, man. I might be having second thoughts about this now that I know there's a chance for you to stalk me.
: But at the same time...it's not like being stalked would be that bad, would it?...
: Uhh...
: Well, uhh...either way, we should probably get a move on if I don't want my dinner to be ice cold by the time I pick it up.
: Sure. I felt weird just standing around without ordering anything anyway.
: Great. It’s not far, I promise. We'll be there in like...fifteen minutes tops.
Haruka and I walk through her neighborhood together, chatting about various cafe-related things to help kill time along the way.
For someone who is apparently extremely lonely, she’s surprisingly good at holding a conversation.
I don't know if I'm only thinking this due to association, but she's kind of like a...more mature version of Rin in a way.
I’m sure all the time she's spent in customer service helps with being able to talk to people, but it’s still surprising getting wrapped up in a conversation this...easy.
Who knows? Maybe she and I just have the type of personalities that bounce well off of one another.
And maybe the natural progression of these first stages of friendship will start feeling a little less natural once she starts letting her guard down.
: Welp, here we are!
: Congratulations on being the first man here in God knows how long.
: Thanks for having me. Also, wow- what a clean living room.
: Thanks for humoring me. I don't get those sorts of casual compliments from Sara.
: Any time she's here, she just goes straight for the wine and it's...off to the races.
: Well, Sara is an alcoholic and I am not. Comparing the two of us doesn't really work all that well.
: Ehh...I don't really know if I'd say that.
: Sara might have a drinking problem, but you guys are actually pretty similar in a bunch of ways.
: What sort of ways are you referring to?
: That's...
: I don't know. It's kind of hard to talk about without making it sound like I'm both judging you and dishing out details about her that she probably wants to be kept secret for now.
: Well, that's not ominous at all.
: S-Since we're on the topic of her, though...there's...
: Well, there's something I've been kind of wondering.
: And if this is too personal or whatever, you can just tell me to mind my own business.
: I think I see where this is going, but shoot. What do you want to know?
: Well, uhh...
: I know you guys have been...you know...intimate with each other...
: But like...are you guys officially a thing? Or just...kinda messing around?
: N-Not like there’s anything wrong with either of those! Like...you’re obviously both consenting adults who seem to like each other and...
: And Sara is certainly very up front about her...needs.
: I guess I'm just kind of curious. That's all.
: I see...
: I'm sorry. That was weird to ask, wasn't it?
: A little, yeah. But I don't really mind.
: The thing is, when it comes to Sara...
: Well, uhh...I know you guys hang out sometimes, but like...
: I also know how Sara is.
: How she is? What do you mean by that?
: She...just...kinda really likes attention.
: Like really likes it...
: Which isn't me talking shit or anything. She has the same needs all of us have.
: And since you're the first guy that's been in her life for like, years-
: I get what you're saying. And I don't know if I should be saying this or not, but she already tried having sex with me once.
: And you...turned her down? But she's so hot.
: She is. But her daughter was also like, two rooms away.
: That...
: Kinda makes it even hotter though...
: Can we pretend I didn't just say that? Because I'm going to pretend I didn't just say that.
: I don't know if I should tell her what you just said or not.
: Please don't. That was supposed to be an internal thought. It just...got out on accident.
: Yeah...I can relate to that.
: So...was it just the thing with her daughter that held you back? Or...do you have like...other reasons?
: Well...
: When it comes to Sara-
I’m interested in her
: I guess I am kind of interested in her. She seems like a really nice girl...just very horny.
: Not like there’s any problem with that. In fact, I-
: I’m...gonna stop you right there.
: I’ve already heard things from her that I can’t unhear.
: Oh? What is that supposed to mean?
: I...am going to keep my comments to myself for right now.
: But if any of it is true...I am both very impressed and extremely jealous. But I would also like you to forget that I just said that.
: I don't know if I can.
: I don’t want to hear wherever this is going.
: Really? Not even a little?
: No way, Jose.
I’m not interested in her
: I don’t really see Sara that way. At least...not right now.
: She’s definitely hot, but...I just can’t really imagine how her daughter would feel if she found out.
: Oh my God, you’re totally right. I didn't even think about that.
: That would be like, super weird for her, wouldn’t it? If my high school teacher was banging my mom, I don't even know what I would have done.
: Exactly. So I think it would probably be for the best right now if Sara and I just...stay the way we are.
: That takes some serious willpower, dude. Sara’s hot as hell. She was really popular back in [high_school] too.
: But...I guess that’s really all I can tell you about that. The rest will have to come from her.
: But anyway, I guess that pretty much answers my question. I was just wondering if you guys were like, exclusive or not.
: Gotcha. Yeah, we’re definitely not exclusive. So if you're trying to flirt with me right now, please be advised that I am 100%% single.
: Oh yeah? Your [niece] wouldn’t get mad if you brought a girlfriend over?
: Well...bringing you over would be a completely different story.
: I’m sure it would be. Us girls can be super protective, you know?
: In fact, this one time-
: Hah-
: I’ll be right back.
The people we love go away sometimes, don’t they?
: I’m back!
: Sorry about that.
: I’m not really sure what came over me right there.
: Great. I’m glad you’re okay now.
: Yup!
: So, where were we?
: Do you miss him? I think you were trying to flirt with me.
: Was I? That doesn’t sound very much like me. Are you sure?
: Tell me about the things you feel. Pretty sure. I guess I could be wrong, though.
: Hmm...I think you are! I’m not really one for flirting, so...
: Do you long to be touched once more? Well, if you ever change your mind...
: If I ever change my mind, what?
: I will defile the body that once belonged to him. I guess we’ll have to find out, won’t we?
: Hmm...
: I guess we will.
Haruka drove me home shortly after that.
Ami yelled at me for forgetting to buy milk, eggs, and water.
All in all, it was a pretty normal day.
Haruka went home and furiously [masturbate]d.
Everyone lived happily ever after.
